en: Long-awaited by Gundam AGE fans! Now available on GunplaHG! !
A white machine that inherits Wolf's legacy ---
Gundam AGE-2 Special Forces Specifications
An impressive white aircraft that appeared in the 28th episode of "Mobile Suit Gundam AGE" (Asemu arc final episode)
Commercialize Gundam AGE-2 Special Forces specification.
The colors that appear in the play are thoroughly pursued with molded colors.
Bold action poses can be reproduced by combining the two-axis movement and rotation axis of each joint.
-Using three different molding colors to express the white color, the finish is closer to the setting!
Attached weapons: Hyper Dods rifle, beam saber x 2
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
